# Webgram IT Solution

> Webgram IT Solution is a Delhi NCR web development company (founded by Vikas Kumar; GST registered and working with clients since 2022; Sangam Vihar, New Delhi) building ecommerce websites, B2B commerce platforms, WooCommerce and Shopify stores, marketplaces and custom web portals for businesses across India.

Contact: +91 7551120242, info@webgramitsolution.in. GSTIN 07CUHPK2017G1ZW. Hours Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 19:00 IST. Pricing is quoted per project after a requirement call; there is no fixed public price list. See [project pricing and quotes](https://webgramitsolution.in/pricing) for scope, cost factors and the quote process.

## Services

- [Ecommerce Development](https://webgramitsolution.in/solutions/ecommerce-development): Online stores with WooCommerce or Shopify, payments, shipping and SEO.
- [B2B Commerce](https://webgramitsolution.in/solutions/b2b-commerce): Wholesale portals with customer pricing, MOQ, RFQ and ERP-ready integrations.
- [Website Design](https://webgramitsolution.in/services/website-design): Business websites designed for enquiries and search.
- [WooCommerce Development](https://webgramitsolution.in/services/woocommerce): WordPress-based stores.
- [Shopify Development](https://webgramitsolution.in/services/shopify): Hosted Shopify stores.
- [Web Portal Development](https://webgramitsolution.in/services/web-portal-development): Custom portals and dashboards.
- [Website Maintenance](https://webgramitsolution.in/services/website-maintenance): Updates, security and support.

## Industries

- [Industries directory](https://webgramitsolution.in/industries): Sector-specific ecommerce and web portal design.
- [Building materials](https://webgramitsolution.in/industries/building-materials): Product specifications, bulk orders and project enquiries.
- [Manufacturing](https://webgramitsolution.in/industries/manufacturing): Technical catalogues and dealer portals.
- [Wholesale](https://webgramitsolution.in/industries/wholesale): Trade terms and repeat ordering.
- [Distribution](https://webgramitsolution.in/industries/distribution): Reseller orders, branch inventory and approvals.
- [Retail](https://webgramitsolution.in/industries/retail), [fashion](https://webgramitsolution.in/industries/fashion), [beauty](https://webgramitsolution.in/industries/beauty), [furniture](https://webgramitsolution.in/industries/furniture) and [electronics](https://webgramitsolution.in/industries/electronics): Storefront design by industry.

## Locations

Webgram’s office is in Sangam Vihar, New Delhi. We serve the listed neighbourhoods, industrial areas and other cities from that office and through remote project delivery.

- [All service areas](https://webgramitsolution.in/locations): Directory of Delhi NCR, Delhi neighbourhood, industrial area and India pages.
- [Delhi](https://webgramitsolution.in/locations/delhi), [Noida](https://webgramitsolution.in/locations/noida), [Gurugram (Gurgaon)](https://webgramitsolution.in/locations/gurugram), [Faridabad](https://webgramitsolution.in/locations/faridabad), [Delhi NCR](https://webgramitsolution.in/locations/delhi-ncr) and [South Delhi](https://webgramitsolution.in/locations/south-delhi).
- [Gujarat](https://webgramitsolution.in/locations/gujarat) and [Ludhiana](https://webgramitsolution.in/locations/ludhiana): Ecommerce, product catalogues and trade portals with remote delivery.
- [India](https://webgramitsolution.in/locations/india): Website development services and remote consultation.
